messages.content: Write REXX to display Hello World

/* REXX - Hello World */
SAY 'Hello World'
Write REXX to read a dataset using EXECIO

/* REXX - Read dataset */
"ALLOC FI(INFILE) DA('MY.INPUT.DATA') SHR REUSE"
"EXECIO * DISKR INFILE (STEM LINE. FINIS"
"FREE FI(INFILE)"

SAY 'Total lines read:' LINE.0
DO I = 1 TO LINE.0
   SAY LINE.I
END
EXIT 0
Write REXX to write to a dataset using EXECIO

/* REXX - Write dataset */
"ALLOC FI(OUTFILE) DA('MY.OUTPUT.DATA') NEW CATALOG",
       "SPACE(1,1) TRACKS LRECL(80) RECFM(F,B) REUSE"

OUTLINE.1 = 'First line of output'
OUTLINE.2 = 'Second line of output'
OUTLINE.3 = 'Third line of output'
OUTLINE.0 = 3

"EXECIO" OUTLINE.0 "DISKW OUTFILE (STEM OUTLINE. FINIS"
"FREE FI(OUTFILE)"

SAY 'Lines written:' OUTLINE.0
EXIT 0
Write REXX with OUTTRAP to capture command output

/* REXX - Capture TSO command output */
X = OUTTRAP('OUTPUT.')
ADDRESS TSO "LISTCAT ENTRIES('SYS1.PARMLIB')"
X = OUTTRAP('OFF')

SAY 'Command output lines:' OUTPUT.0
DO I = 1 TO OUTPUT.0
   SAY OUTPUT.I
END
EXIT 0
Write REXX with PARSE statement

/* REXX - Parse example */
INPUT_STRING = 'JOHN,DOE,35,ENGINEER'

PARSE VAR INPUT_STRING FIRST ',' LAST ',' AGE ',' JOB

SAY 'First Name:' FIRST
SAY 'Last Name:' LAST
SAY 'Age:' AGE
SAY 'Job:' JOB

/* Parse with template */
DATE_STRING = '2024-01-15'
PARSE VAR DATE_STRING YEAR '-' MONTH '-' DAY
SAY 'Year:' YEAR 'Month:' MONTH 'Day:' DAY
EXIT 0
Write REXX with DO loop

/* REXX - Loop examples */
TOTAL = 0

/* DO with counter */
DO I = 1 TO 10
   TOTAL = TOTAL + I
   SAY 'I =' I 'TOTAL =' TOTAL
END

/* DO WHILE */
COUNT = 0
DO WHILE COUNT < 5
   COUNT = COUNT + 1
   SAY 'COUNT =' COUNT
END

/* DO UNTIL */
NUM = 0
DO UNTIL NUM >= 3
   NUM = NUM + 1
   SAY 'NUM =' NUM
END
EXIT 0
Write REXX with SELECT WHEN

/* REXX - SELECT example */
GRADE = 'B'

SELECT
   WHEN GRADE = 'A' THEN
      RESULT = 'Excellent'
   WHEN GRADE = 'B' THEN
      RESULT = 'Good'
   WHEN GRADE = 'C' THEN
      RESULT = 'Average'
   WHEN GRADE = 'D' THEN
      RESULT = 'Below Average'
   WHEN GRADE = 'F' THEN
      RESULT = 'Failing'
   OTHERWISE
      RESULT = 'Invalid Grade'
END

SAY 'Grade:' GRADE 'Result:' RESULT
EXIT 0
Write REXX function example

/* REXX - Function example */
NUM1 = 10
NUM2 = 20

SUM_RESULT = ADD_NUMBERS(NUM1, NUM2)
SAY 'Sum of' NUM1 'and' NUM2 'is' SUM_RESULT

MAX_RESULT = FIND_MAX(NUM1, NUM2)
SAY 'Max of' NUM1 'and' NUM2 'is' MAX_RESULT

EXIT 0

ADD_NUMBERS: PROCEDURE
   ARG A, B
   RETURN A + B

FIND_MAX: PROCEDURE
   ARG A, B
   IF A > B THEN RETURN A
   ELSE RETURN B
Write REXX with DATE and TIME functions

/* REXX - Date and Time functions */
SAY 'Date functions:'
SAY 'DATE() =' DATE()
SAY 'DATE(U) =' DATE('U')    /* USA format */
SAY 'DATE(E) =' DATE('E')    /* European format */
SAY 'DATE(S) =' DATE('S')    /* Sorted format YYYYMMDD */
SAY 'DATE(J) =' DATE('J')    /* Julian YYDDD */
SAY 'DATE(W) =' DATE('W')    /* Weekday */

SAY ''
SAY 'Time functions:'
SAY 'TIME() =' TIME()
SAY 'TIME(C) =' TIME('C')    /* Civil time */
SAY 'TIME(L) =' TIME('L')    /* Long format */
SAY 'TIME(S) =' TIME('S')    /* Seconds since midnight */
EXIT 0
Write REXX with LISTDSI function

/* REXX - LISTDSI example */
DSNAME = 'SYS1.PARMLIB'

X = LISTDSI("'"DSNAME"'")

IF X = 0 THEN DO
   SAY 'Dataset:' SYSDSNAME
   SAY 'Volume:' SYSVOLUME
   SAY 'Unit:' SYSUNIT
   SAY 'DSORG:' SYSDSORG
   SAY 'RECFM:' SYSRECFM
   SAY 'LRECL:' SYSLRECL
   SAY 'BLKSIZE:' SYSBLKSIZE
   SAY 'Primary:' SYSPRIMARY SYSUNITS
   SAY 'Used:' SYSUSED
END
ELSE DO
   SAY 'LISTDSI failed with RC:' X
   SAY 'Reason:' SYSREASON
END
EXIT 0
